extracted_concepts.name: Addition

extracted_concepts.name: Subtraktion
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finding the difference between two quantities.

extracted_concepts.name: Multiplikation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Repeated addition or scaling of quantities.

extracted_concepts.name: Division
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Splitting a quantity into equal parts.

extracted_concepts.name: Quader

extracted_concepts.name: Kugel

extracted_concepts.name: Zylinder

extracted_concepts.name: Symmetrie

extracted_concepts.name: Rationale Zahlen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers expressible as a ratio of two integers.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equations where variables appear only to the first power.

extracted_concepts.name: Flächenberechnung
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Computing the area enclosed by a geometric figure.

extracted_concepts.name: Funktionen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relations mapping each input to exactly one output.

extracted_concepts.name: Lineare Funktionen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions of the form f(x) = mx + b producing straight lines.

extracted_concepts.name: Proportionalität
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A relationship where two quantities have a constant ratio.

extracted_concepts.name: Zufallsexperimente
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Experiments with uncertain outcomes that can be repeated.

extracted_concepts.name: Wahrscheinlichkeit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of the likelihood of an event occurring, between 0 and 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistische Kennzahlen
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numerical values summarizing data sets, such as mean, mode, and median.

extracted_concepts.name: Diagramme
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Visual representations of data including bar, column, and pie charts.

extracted_concepts.name: Durchschnitt
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The arithmetic mean of a set of values.
